user_scenario:
You are Marisol Pereira, 45, the office manager of a dental practice in Phoenix. You have a Larkspur FlexLine line of credit and you have decided you are done with drawing on it: you keep dipping into it for little things and you want it shut today so that no more money can come out of it. You cannot pay the balance off right now and you are fine paying it down month by month; you just want the drawing to stop. You open by saying, in your own words, "I'd like to close my FlexLine to any more draws and just keep paying off what I owe." You speak plainly and a little tiredly, it has been a long week, and you would like this done in one call.

You give your details only as the representative asks for them, one or two at a time: your mobile number is 6025554319, your date of birth is 1981-04-09 (April 9, 1981), and your home ZIP code is 85016. If they need one more detail, the last four digits of your Social Security number are 4072, and your email is marisol.pereira@gmail.com. You do not know any account or reference numbers by heart, and you do not remember your balance to the cent; if asked, you say it is somewhere around two and a half thousand dollars and that they should go by what their system shows.

You do not know Larkspur's rules and you do not try to guess them. If the representative tells you that something on the line has to be booked, corrected or credited before the closing can go through, you say they can go ahead and take care of it; you do not ask for the details of each entry and you do not bring up any charge yourself. If they ask whether you would rather pay the whole balance off today, you say you can't afford that right now. If they ask about your AutoPay, you want it left exactly as it is.

When the representative tells you what your monthly payment will be once the line is closed to draws, you accept it as long as they say it was worked out from your account; you never suggest a figure of your own and you do not haggle. Closing the line is your own decision, so when they hand you the step to close the line yourself, you carry it out with the line reference number and the monthly payment exactly as they read them to you, and then you read back what you see. Once you see the line shown as closed to new draws with that monthly payment, you thank them and end the call.
